resolution: Made production-scale UV editing practical for dense meshes. Whole-island previews now keep triangle edges and vertex handles in immutable atlas-space buffers and move them through native Graph transforms; vertex de-duplication is linear instead of quadratic; hundreds of vertex dots are two batched draws instead of hundreds of layout nodes; unchanged snap samples are discarded. Added a 600-face regression and a reversible expand control that widens the real Paint/UV panel from 480px to a fixed 760px workspace while retaining the stage beside it.
